name: Voronoi-based Customization Volume Generation
aliases: Discrete Voronoi Diagram Calculation on GPU
definition: A two-pass compute-shader method to generate a 3D customization volume. Pass 1 creates a discrete Voronoi diagram storing the index of the nearest seed customization point for each voxel. Pass 2 computes the final customization value for each voxel using natural neighbor interpolation based on the Voronoi cell membership.
summary: Voronoi-based Customization Volume Generation creates low-resolution 3D volumes via discrete GPU Voronoi diagrams and natural neighbor interpolation, decoupling customization resolution from input data size for interactive performance.
